extracted.intended_audience: reporters, editors, newsroom leaders, and other journalists covering transgender people and related stories
extracted.subtask_description: Announces an updated, expanded, and searchable style guide for reporting on transgender people; describes the guide's sections, revisions, and additions to improve journalistic coverage across beats and mediums.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-level editorial best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: A section of the guide organizing high-level editorial best practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Restructured the guide to organize it by sections, including high-level editorial best practices intended to guide editors and reporters across beats and mediums.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gender, name, and pronoun usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on correct usage of gender, names, and pronouns when reporting on trans people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included as a dedicated section to help journalists use respectful, accurate language about gender, names, and pronouns; part of the guide's effort to improve news coverage of trans people.

rubrics_metrics.name: Politicized or inaccurate phrases
rubrics_metrics.description: Identification of politicized or inaccurate phrases to avoid in coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide flags politicized or inaccurate phrases and provides alternatives to improve accuracy and reduce bias in reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical guides / beat-specific topical guides
rubrics_metrics.description: Topical guides addressing common coverage areas, with established beat-specific guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Established beat-specific topical guides on common coverage areas to provide reporters with context-relevant guidance for different beats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visuals standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and guidance for visuals used in coverage of trans people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A section on visuals standards provides guidance on respectful and appropriate imagery and visual representation in reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Glossary
rubrics_metrics.description: Glossary of terms related to transgender coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes definitions to clarify terminology for journalists and editors; helps ensure consistent, accurate usage across stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Further reading / external best-practice resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Curated further reading and inclusion of best-practice resources from other journalism organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where applicable, the guide includes best-practice resources from other journalism organizations to supplement its guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expanded enterprise guidance for breaking news
rubrics_metrics.description: Enterprise reporting guidance that addresses common reporting issues and limitations during breaking news events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Added entries based on feedback to guide reporters and standards desks on what to do during breaking news situations and how to manage limitations and fast-changing information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural competence and context
rubrics_metrics.description: Emphasis on cultural competence and contextual reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Edited existing entries to focus on cultural competence and context, and to provide advice applicable across beats and mediums.

rubrics_metrics.name: Medium-specific best practices for multimedia reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Best practices tailored to multimedia reporting formats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New additions include medium-specific best practices for multimedia reporting, with an intention to continue expanding these entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searchable landing page and improved usability
rubrics_metrics.description: A searchable, interactive landing page for the style guidance to improve usability and update speed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implemented interactive search options and a searchable landing page (built with donated web development) to make the guidance easier to use and quicker to update as language evolves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoiding outdated and quickly changing references
rubrics_metrics.description: Removal or updating of materials and references that are out of date or would require frequent updates (e.g., statistics).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updated materials that were accurate as of 2019 but now out of date; removed references to statistics and other quickly changing information that would have to be regularly updated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combining related entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Consolidation of related guidance entries to reduce redundancy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Related entries were combined to streamline the guide and improve clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separation of newsroom/workplace policy topics
rubrics_metrics.description: Removal of topics related to newsroom or workplace policy from the public style guide and placement in a separate resource.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Topics related to newsroom/workplace policy were removed and will be included in a separated, expanded newsroom policy best practices resource.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community consultation and contributor review
rubrics_metrics.description: The revision process included contributions and reviews by TJA members and consultation with other journalism organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: More than 20 TJA members (editors, reporters, and newsroom leaders) contributed to the revision, and TJA consulted other journalism affinity organizations to review specific entries, indicating a collaborative, peer-reviewed development process.
